REMARKS
Claims 1–7, 10–17, and 20 are pending, with claims 1 and 11 being independent. Claims 1 and 11 are amended. Claims 8–9 and 18–19 were previously canceled. No new claims are added in this paper.
In taking the foregoing actions, Applicant respectfully submits Applicant is not necessarily conceding in this application that these claims, as originally presented, are not patentable over the references cited by the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO), as pertinent ones of the present claim amendments and cancellations are only for facilitating expeditious prosecution. Applicant respectfully reserves the right to pursue the canceled claims and/or other claims in one or more continuing applications.
Request for Continued Examination under 37 C.F.R § 1.114
Concurrently with this response, Applicant has filed a Request for Continued Examination with the appropriate fee. Applicant respectfully request that prosecution be reopened and all prior rejections be withdrawn.
Claim Objections
Claim 11 was objected to for including terms with “no clear antecedent basis”. Office Action, p. 3.
Without conceding the propriety of the rejection, and solely in the interests of advancing prosecution, Applicant has hereinabove amended claim 11 per the Examiner’s suggestion. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully submits that these objections are now moot, and respectfully requests the withdrawal of these objections.
Rejections under 35 U.S.C. § 112
Claims 11-17 and 20 were rejected pursuant to 35 U.S.C. § 112 as allegedly indefinite for failing to particularly point out and distinctly claim the subject matter which the inventor regards as his invention. Office Action, p. 3.
Specifically, the Examiner alleges “[c]laim 11 recites the limitation “the main linkage” in line 6. There is insufficient antecedent basis for this limitation in the claim.” In response, Applicant has hereinabove amended claim 11 to rectify the antecedent basis.
Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests that all rejections of claims pursuant to 35 U.S.C. § 112 be removed.
Double Patenting
Application No. 18/373,690
Claims 1-7, 10-17, and 20 stand rejected on the alleged ground of non-statutory double patenting as being unpatentable over claims 1-20 of Application No. 18/373,690. Office Action, p. 3-5.
Though Applicant may not necessarily acquiesce to the grounds of the asserted double patenting rejections, a Terminal Disclaimer in compliance with 37 CFR 1.321 (c) or 1.321 (d) has been submitted or is being submitted herewith to obviate these non-statutory double patenting rejections.
Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration and withdrawal of all double patenting rejections of the claims.
Conclusion
Accordingly, Applicant respectfully submits that all claims in the application are in a condition for allowance and respectfully solicits the prompt issuance of a Notice of Allowance. If any issues remain, the Examiner is encouraged to call the undersigned practitioner at the number listed below.
Respectfully submitted,
Date: December 05, 2024 /SHIXIONG WANG/
